title: Arrangement of the Camp

questions.question: Which camp was to set out first?
questions.explanation: Numbers 2:9 (ESV): "They shall set out first on the march." (referring to Judah camp).

questions.question: Which side of the tabernacle did Judah, Issachar, and Zebulun camp?
questions.explanation: Numbers 2:3 (ESV): "Those to camp on the east side... were of the standard of the camp of Judah."

questions.question: Who camped on the south side?
questions.explanation: Numbers 2:10 (ESV): "On the south side shall be the standard of the camp of Reuben..."

questions.question: Where was the Tent of Meeting located relative to the camps?
options: In the midst of the camps
questions.correctAnswer: In the midst of the camps
questions.explanation: Numbers 2:17 (ESV): "Then the tent of meeting shall set out, with the camp of the Levites in the midst of the camps."

questions.question: Who camped on the west side?
options: The standard of the camp of Ephraim
questions.correctAnswer: The standard of the camp of Ephraim
questions.explanation: Numbers 2:18 (ESV): "On the west side shall be the standard of the camp of Ephraim..."

questions.question: Which tribe was the leader of the north camp?
questions.explanation: Numbers 2:25 (ESV): "On the north side shall be the standard of the camp of Dan..."

questions.question: How were the Israelites to camp?
options: Each by his own standard, with the banners of their fathers' houses
questions.correctAnswer: Each by his own standard, with the banners of their fathers' houses
questions.explanation: Numbers 2:2 (ESV): "The people of Israel shall camp each by his own standard, with the banners of their fathers' houses."

questions.question: What was the total number of the camp of Ephraim (West)?
questions.explanation: Numbers 2:24 (ESV): "All those listed of the camp of Ephraim... were 108,100."

questions.question: Which camp set out last ("rear guard")?
questions.explanation: Numbers 2:31 (ESV): "They shall set out last, standard by standard." (referring to Dan camp).

questions.question: What was the total number of the camp of Reuben (South)?
questions.explanation: Numbers 2:16 (ESV): "All those listed of the camp of Reuben... were 151,450."

questions.question: The camp of the Levites set out after which camp?
questions.explanation: Numbers 2:17 follows the description of Reuben setting out second (v16). So Levites were in the middle.

questions.question: Which tribes were with Ephraim on the west?
questions.explanation: Numbers 2:20, 22 (ESV): "Next to him... Manasseh... Then... Benjamin."

questions.question: What was the total number of the camp of Dan (North)?
questions.explanation: Numbers 2:31 (ESV): "All those listed of the camp of Dan were 157,600."

questions.question: How did they camp relative to the Tent of Meeting?
questions.explanation: Numbers 2:2 (ESV): "They shall camp facing the tent of meeting on every side."

questions.question: Did the Levites have a standard mentioned in this chapter?
options: No, they were not listed among the camps
questions.correctAnswer: No, they were not listed among the camps
questions.explanation: Numbers 2:33 (ESV): "But the Levites were not listed among the people of Israel, as the Lord commanded Moses."

key_verse_text: Then the tent of meeting shall set out, with the camp of the Levites in the midst of the camps; as they camp, so shall they set out, each in position, standard by standard.
